_doc: Farhold's talents. Emberveil's talents modify named skills, and Farhold has no skill bar, so its talent levels would have handed out points with nothing to spend them on. These are broad masteries instead — every one of them changes a number the game already reads, so none of them is decoration. Taken one per talent level (3, 8, 13, 18, 23, 28). R21 checked every line against its own `grants`: Hardy said its 2 health a second was 'out of combat' and js/main.js adds `hpRegen` on every regen tick whether you are fighting or not, so the text was wrong rather than the number; Reaver now says which hits life steal actually pays on (melee and ranged physical, never a spell or a wand or a staff), matching js/effects.js; and Deep Lungs no longer promises you 'float higher', because `floatLift` is declared in js/rpg.js's derived table and READ BY NOTHING — the 0.15 is left in place so the stat is still findable, but a description must not promise a rule the game does not run.

talents.name: Hardy
talents.desc: +2 health a second, in a fight or out of one

talents.name: Reaver
talents.desc: 6% Life Steal on melee and ranged physical hits (not spells, wands or staves)
